notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Added options for motion blur and global illumination raytracing method (software or hardware)
- Input re-mappings are now properly saved
- Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause players to get stuck when statues moved nearby

notes.title: Lazaret Out Now!
notes.content: It took a lot longer than we originally thought, but the full version of Lazaret is finally out now!

notes.title: Lazaret Releases February 20th
notes.content: It's been a long time coming but Lazaret is finally ready for release on February 20th. The store page has been updated with new screenshots and a new release trailer.
